insight.headline: GraphQL Admin API Error
insight.what_changed: The GraphQL Admin API now returns an error when a query filters by a metafield that isn't set up for filtering. This change starts in API version 2026-10. Previously, the API would silently return incorrect results.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should update their GraphQL queries to handle the new error response. They should also ensure that their metafields are properly set up for filtering. This change may break existing queries, so thorough testing is necessary. The `metafield` argument in the `filter` parameter of the `query` field will now throw an error if the metafield is not configured for filtering.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants may notice more accurate results from apps using the GraphQL Admin API, as incorrect results will now be caught and reported as errors.
insight.why_it_matters: This change improves the reliability and accuracy of the GraphQL Admin API, reducing the risk of incorrect results being returned to merchants.
insight.code_example: query { products(filter: { metafield: { key: "my_metafield", value: "my_value" } }) { edges { node { title } } } }

updates.title: POS UI extensions can now print directly to hardware receipt printers
updates.summary: POS UI extensions can now print directly to hardware receipt printers using the Printing API. This allows extensions to discover and send documents to connected receipt printers.

updates.title: Invalid metafield queries now return errors in the GraphQL Admin API
updates.summary: The GraphQL Admin API now returns errors for invalid metafield queries, instead of silently returning incorrect results, starting in API version 2026-10.

updates.title: Metafield triggers and additional topics are now available for Events
updates.summary: Metafield triggers and additional topics are now available for Events, allowing apps to subscribe to events for various resources and metafield changes.

updates.title: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials
updates.summary: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials, simplifying theme page building in the Liquid July ’26 developer preview.

updates.title: Full-stack capabilities to power app analytics
updates.summary: Full-stack capabilities are now available to power app analytics, making it easier for app developers to build merchant-facing analytics.

updates.title: Physical inventory feature preview
updates.summary: The physical inventory feature preview provides early access to new inventory APIs in the unstable version of the GraphQL Admin API.
The CLI 4.5.2 update fixes a warning when running theme commands in valid theme directories and bumps Shopify/theme-tools packages.

updates.title: Card deposit endpoint now requires mTLS certificate
updates.summary: The card deposit endpoint now requires a Shopify-issued mTLS client certificate, affecting apps that store cardholder data.

updates.title: @shopify/cli-hydrogen@13.0.2
updates.summary: The @shopify/cli-hydrogen@13.0.2 update adds non-interactive shop and storefront creation flags to hydrogen link and allows bypassing confirmation prompts in hydrogen upgrade.

updates.title: Updated App Store requirements: 4.1.2 Use a unique name for your app
updates.summary: The App Store requirements have been updated to include the use of a unique name for apps, reducing merchant confusion over identical and copyleft app names.

updates.title: Storefront API `@inContext` supports `channelId`
updates.summary: The Storefront API @inContext directive now supports the channelId argument, allowing apps to apply a specific sales channel’s context to an entire query.

updates.title: `productId`, `title`,`variantSku`, and `variantTitle` fields added to `ExchangeLineItem`
updates.summary: The ExchangeLineItem type now includes productId, title, variantSku, and variantTitle fields, providing more information about exchange line items.

recap.headline: Shopify updates enhance POS UI extensions and GraphQL Admin API error handling

themes.title: POS UI Extensions
themes.detail: The Printing API (shopify.printing) is introduced in POS UI Extensions 2026-07, enabling extensions to discover and print directly to hardware receipt printers using getPrinters(). This update streamlines the printing process for merchants.

themes.title: GraphQL Admin API Improvements
themes.detail: Starting in API version 2026-10, the GraphQL Admin API will return an error when a query filters by a metafield that isn't set up for filtering, instead of returning incorrect results. This change improves the accuracy and reliability of metafield queries.
